criteriaResults.criteriaId: <uuid of the criteria | type: string | eg: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000>
criteriaResults.passed: <whether the criteria is passed | type: boolean | eg: true>
criteriaResults.feedback: <brief explanation of why it passed or failed | type: string | eg: Code handles all edge cases correctly.>
criteriaResults.location: <file path with line number or null if passed | type: string | null | eg: src/utils/math.ts:42>
criteriaResults.suggestion: <suggested fix or null if passed | type: string | null | eg: Consider using Math.abs()>
criteriaResults.score: <score for this criteria | type: number | eg: 10>
